input.quote: 8.2 Exclusivity of Efforts. Prior to the [ * ], neither Ono or its Affiliates, nor Array or its Controlled Affiliates, shall Commercialize in the Ono Territory:
input.rationale: Section 8.2 imposes an exclusive-dealing covenant on Ono (and its Affiliates), barring Commercialization of any Competing Product in the Ono Territory for an undefined, redacted period, plus a further post-termination tail running to the [ * ] anniversary of termination. The covenant is limited to a defined product category (the "Competing Product" definition), which satisfies the first fallback element, but it exceeds 12 months and contains no automatic exit for Array's failure to meet service levels or delivery dates — Ono's only relief is if Array itself commercializes a Competing Product. That is walk-away territory (exclusive dealing for the full term with no performance-based exit), so we redline to the fallback. Article IX is not a second exclusivity: Array supplies "Ono's requirements" only where Ono elects to order, and Section 9.4(a) expressly gives Ono the right (but not the obligation) to Manufacture or engage a Subcontractor, so Ono is free to use alternatives. Array's reciprocal covenant benefits Ono and is preserved; we also conformed Array's Section 8.2 termination trigger so it cannot bite after Ono's capped covenant expires (Section 14 relies on that cross-reference).

proposal.summary: Cap Ono's Section 8.2 non-compete at 12 months and add automatic termination on Array's supply performance failures; conform Array's termination trigger.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 8.2 binds Ono to an open-ended non-compete with no performance-based exit, so we capped Ono's side at twelve (12) months and made it end automatically if Array misses service levels or delivery dates. Array's reciprocal covenant is untouched, and we conformed Array's termination trigger to the capped covenant.

ops.text: The obligations of Ono and its Affiliates under this Section 8.2 shall in no event continue beyond the twelve (12) month anniversary of the Effective Date, and shall terminate automatically if Array fails to meet the service levels or delivery dates under any supply agreement between the Parties.

ops.oldText: If Ono Commercializes a Competing Product in the Ono Territory during [ * ], Array may immediately terminate this Agreement.
ops.newText: If Ono Commercializes a Competing Product in the Ono Territory in breach of this Section 8.2, Array may immediately terminate this Agreement.

mappings.element: Exclusivity is limited to a defined product category.
mappings.quote: (i) a product that includes, as an active pharmaceutical ingredient, an agent that is a [ * ] (other than Binimetinib), or (ii) a product that includes, as an active pharmaceutical ingredient, an agent that is a [ * ] (other than Encorafenib), or grant the right to a licensee or distributor to Commercialize in the Ono Territory any of the above described products (each a "Competing Product").

mappings.element: Exclusivity lasts no longer than 12 months.
Exclusivity ends automatically if Vendor fails to meet service levels.
Exclusivity ends automatically if Vendor fails to meet delivery dates.
